standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback compatibility
standard_prerequisites.use: For f = g o f-prime the pullbacks (f-prime)^* of g^* of A and f^* of A agree by functoriality of pullback.

core_obligations: Unfold both functors on a test scheme: a pair (f-prime, varphi-prime) for (S-prime, A-prime) is a pair (f, varphi) for (S, A) together with the factorization f = g o f-prime, via (f-prime)^* A-prime = (f-prime)^* g^* A = f^* A.
The correspondence is functorial in the test scheme, giving the canonical isomorphism F-prime = h_{S-prime} x_{h_S} F.
proof_roadmap: Unfold the pair data across the base change, identify by the displayed chain, conclude.
difficulty_reason: Data-level identification of pairs over the pulled-back algebra with pairs over the original algebra factoring through g; fully displayed.
